content: Service name: Com_MainFunctionRx Syntax: void Com_MainFunctionRx( void ) Service ID[hex]: 0x18 Description: This function performs the processing of the AUTOSAR COM module's receive processing that are not directly handled within the COM's functions invoked by the PDU - R, for example Com_RxIndication.
